# Phase 1 baseline pilot

Reproduction from repository root:

```sh
uv sync
uv run python scripts/fetch_data.py
uv run pytest -q
uv run python scripts/run_phase1.py
```

Seed: 20261113. All intervals use 2,000 cluster bootstrap replicates. Baseline estimate is paired Brier difference versus mean; low/high are its percentile CI; fraction_lt_zero is the bootstrap fraction below zero, not a p-value. Brier is the absolute mean loss. N counts panels and distinct question clusters after fold-specific eligibility filtering. Correlations are Pearson correlations across eligible forecaster/target pairs, with question-cluster intervals. Farming inflation is control minus farmed loss, with forecaster-cluster intervals. Hyperparameters and training counts are recorded per fold in hyperparameters.json. Tables are descriptive; shared source/date shocks are not separately clustered. At the 11-ID threshold ASOF PUB retains only one panel (one question cluster); its degenerate bootstrap interval does not provide useful evidence of stability. See DATA_AUDIT.md for chronology and operational choices.

## Revised analysis (post-audit)

The pre-registered farming attacker (+0.0065 raw) is the confirmatory Phase 1 farming result. Confident disclosure is exploratory in origin. Test ledgers now exclude their own target only; training ledgers exclude all test-fold ids. Oracle uses hidden group labels and applies only to MIX. Equal8 shows exactly eight seeded ids with one unit per id. Pigeonhole weights are the product of the question multiplicity and every member multiplicity, independently resampling question and forecaster ids. These intervals hold records and fitted hyperparameters fixed.
